answer_1.quote: We propose a UNIfied Causal videO-oRiented laNguage modeling framework (UNICORN) that unifies the tasks as a simple yet generic language modeling problem.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates text outputs such as temporal timestamps (e.g., <16><48>) for moment retrieval and descriptive paragraphs for video paragraph captioning.

answer_2.quote: For moment retrieval, we evaluate on QVHighlights, Charades-STA, and ActivityNet Captions. We report the standard metrics Recall at 1 under temporal Intersection over Union (IoU) thresholds of 0.5 and 0.7, abbreviated as R@0.5 and R@0.7. Besides, we use the average mAP over IoU thresholds [0.5:0.05:0.95] on QVHighlights... For video paragraph captioning, we use commonly-adopted metrics CIDEr (C) and METEOR (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005) (M)... SODA_c ) (S) is also used to measure the temporal coherence for a set of captions.
